title: Common-stage adic compactification and section comparison data
statement: Fix a finite adic compactification-section data family and an algebraic closure Omega/Q_ell, in an independent universe. Define its common-stage extension data on the actual constructible common-stage hearts. For each separated finite-type k-scheme W include the coefficient unit identified with the actual coefficient unit at every finite field, the finite-stage heart inclusions with their underlying common-stage functors and unit comparisons, and a natural Omega-linear identification of the actual ordinary H^0 objects with Hom from the unit. Its restriction to every finite field is ordinary scalar extension, with the finite Hom formula on 1 tensor x. For each quasi-compact open immersion j:U->T include an additive functor preserving finite limits and finite colimits and identified on all morphisms with the specified normalized compact-support coefficient action for (j,id_T), completed pullback and the open adjunction with invertible unit. Include finite-stage extension and restriction comparisons preserving both the coefficient unit and open adjunction unit, ordinary restriction with its Hom formula, and the inside and outside comparisons for the specified adic fibres. For proper T include the actual compact H_c^0 objects, natural Omega-linear Hom identification, compactification comparison with H^0(T,j!F), compact-to-ordinary restriction formula, and finite-stage natural comparisons whose values on 1 tensor x are the finite compact Hom and compact-to-ordinary formulas. Thus the functors and comparisons act on all common-stage arrows, not merely on objects. The Omega-action is transported from the unique finite-representative scalar action along the recorded closure-size equivalence. Use exactly [def-a1-finite-adic-compactification-section-data] [def-a1-common-adic-section-data] [def-a1-common-adic-open-section-data] [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] [def-weil-constructible-heart] [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres] [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] [lem-sf-field-stage-ordinary-realization]. The finite-stage compactification equation identifies common compactification on 1 tensor x with the actual finite compactification map, followed by the finite-to-common ordinary-stage and open-extension comparisons. Its hom_stage and comparison_stage equations similarly preserve the normalized finite compact Hom and the independently constructed derived compact-to-ordinary arrow. The compact_stage map is normalized to the actual scalar-unit map on the recorded compact cohomology objects through the literal finite-stage inclusion. The restriction formula is a separate equation.
